title: EffectCraft .aep import/export test corpus
built_with: Adobe After Effects 26.5x89 (ExtendScript, background instance), Windows 11
path_layout: Footage is referenced as <root>/media/... from <root>/aep/ae2026_v26/*.aep; keep this relative layout. Absolute path stored in the .aep: D:/AI_ZONE/Commerical/AE_IDEAS/effectcraft-aep-corpus/media/...
older_formats: Not included: AE 2024/2025 are not installed on the build PC (only leftover folders), and AE 2026 'Save a Copy As 25.x/24.x' crashes the windowless AE instance.
reference_render: aerender, Best Settings, PNG sequence RGB+alpha of the main comp (every frame, 0-based numbering [#####]) + H.264 15 Mbps; extra comps one PNG frame at t=1s. Times in reference/timings.

feature_files.note: Solids (incl. PAR 2), null parent with rotation keys, adjustment layer with a mask limiting Hue/Saturation + Gaussian Blur, disabled/guide/shy/locked/draft layers, trimmed in/out, label+comment, purple comp background.

tests: linear & radial gradient fill (default white-black colors)
stroke over fill, tracking, all caps, justification
text on mask path, first margin keys
H.264 MP4 1280x720 30fps (embedded AAC, audio switched off)
WAV stereo 48k with audio level fades
precomp at different fps (25) and size
precomp instance with negative start time
rotobezier open mask driving Stroke effect
one matte shared by two layers, matte not adjacent, animated
two-node camera with DOF, animated position
one-node camera with Z rotation (2nd comp)
spatial bezier tangents + roving key + auto-orient along path
time remap slow-mo on video with frame mix blending
text layer parented to animated layer
Essential Properties on precomp: Title Text, Badge Color, Badge Scale, Icon Opacity, Icon Rotation
3 instances: defaults, static overrides (text/color/scale/opacity/rotation), keyframed overrides

combined: blurred plate, inverted feathered mask multiply vignette, 3D precomp card with text animator + trim path + drop shadow, camera dolly, repeater sparks with glow (add mode), audio, null parent with expression
linear blending / linearized working space (if supported)
proxy set but disabled on precomp

effects_sweep.description: Every built-in effect (Adobe, Cycore CC, Keylight, Mocha, Immersive, obsolete) found in AE 26.5, each on its own 320x180 2 s comp with DEFAULT parameters applied to a shared source precomp (SWEEP_SOURCE: photo plate + moving grid PNG; audio effects on a WAV layer). <Category>_contact tiles them 6 per row.
